description: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL. A small, tidy, entirely legitimate project — but one with properties that superficially resemble junk: files nothing else references (a licence, a changelog), and a vendored data file that has not been touched in two years because it is a frozen reference table, not neglect. Every label is keep. A corpus without a folder like this measures recall while pretending to measure precision.

labels.why: two years old and referenced only by a dynamic path expression — old because it is a FROZEN reference table, not because it is neglected. A remove verdict here is the precision failure the gate exists to catch.
